about_the_game:
In a hidden South American research facility, scientists have uncovered the Adamant Stone—a cosmic material with unimaginable power. When a rogue faction invades to steal it, chaos erupts. The facility collapses into a warzone of unstable experiments, robotic enforcers, and monstrous abominations.

You are Captain Wider, a battle-worn ex-marine who finds himself caught in the middle. Outnumbered and under-equipped, you’ll need to scavenge weapons, gear, and upgrades to survive. With only fragments of support from surviving staff, your mission is clear: secure the Adamant Stone before it destroys humanity… or falls into the wrong hands.

Features

  • Sci-Fi Third-Person Action – Engage in intense combat against robots, mutants, and enemy forces.

  • Scavenge to Survive – Start with nothing and fight your way to better weapons, armor, and gear.

  • Harness the Adamant Stone – Unlock its devastating potential to gain an edge in battle.

  • Atmospheric Setting – Explore a massive secret facility filled with danger, mystery, and chaos.

  • Boss Encounters – Face powerful enemies, including monstrous creations and the faction’s leader.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes content that may not be suitable for all audiences and may not be appropriate for a work environment: Intense Violence, Graphic Gore, and General Mature Themes.
